europe_now.title: US demands participation for Europe in upcoming Ukraine peace talks
europe_now.summary: United States officials have stated that Europe must be included in the next rounds of negotiations concerning the conflict in Ukraine. Trilateral talks are currently underway in Abu Dhabi involving Russia, Ukraine, and international participants.

europe_now.title: France opens investigation into Iranian cyber unit over supermarket attacks
europe_now.summary: Paris prosecutors have initiated a formal inquiry targeting an Iranian cyber unit following cyberattacks directed at supermarket refrigeration systems in France. French authorities formally attributed the disruptive digital incident to Iran.

top_stories.title: Trilateral Peace Negotiations on Ukraine
top_stories.summary: Diplomatic efforts regarding the ongoing conflict in Ukraine continue with trilateral meetings held in Abu Dhabi. American officials report that the warring sides are demonstrating a degree of flexibility during these discussions.

europe_now.summary: United States officials have stated that Washington is demanding a seat for Europe in upcoming peace negotiations regarding Ukraine. The diplomatic engagement comes amid trilateral talks held in Abu Dhabi with representatives from Russia, Ukraine, and the US.

europe_now.title: France Blames Iran for Cyberattack
europe_now.summary: The French government has publicly blamed Iran for a cyberattack targeting supermarket refrigeration units. The Paris prosecutor's office has opened a formal probe into an Iranian cyber unit regarding the incident.

top_stories.title: Military Exercises in Poland
